_note: Placement of each uezd scan in the combined canvas (pixels of the CURRENT canvas, whose origin is the top-left of the Бобруйск scan). canvas = scan_xy @ [[cos,sin],[-sin,cos]] + t. Бобруйск/Речица are pure shifts; Мозырь fitted to its Бобруйск+Речица borders (tools: ICP on outlines; geography check with Мозырь/Петриков/Копаткевичи/Ельск gave the same scale, 1.02). Пинск additionally has 'scale' (its scan is at 88 px/km vs ~115 for the others): canvas = scale * scan_xy @ Rot + t.

mozyr.fit: border ICP, 382 pairs, mean gap 121 px (~1 km)

pinsk.fit: scale from geography (Пинск/Лунинец/Столин vs Мозырь towns: 88.2 vs 113.8 px/km); rotation+shift by border ICP vs Мозырь, 232 pairs, mean gap 59 px
